strategy: Joint (a, b, U, theta) maximization of the normalized margin m at n = 6 and n = 7 with the shared toolkit (smooth_maximize: annealed L-BFGS, log-sum-exp over all n! permutation products, vectorized; then active-set polish). Six start families cycled per restart: generic (Haar U), ostar (O*/7 plus a Haar block, permuted, rotated by cayley(eps K), eps in {0, 0.1, 0.3}), dft (Fourier matrix with random phases and permutations, eps in {0, 0.05, 0.2}), tensor (U2 x U3, plus 1 at n = 7, eps in {0, 0.1, 0.3}), dsum (Haar(k) + Haar(n-k) rotated, eps in {0.1, 0.3, 0.6}), edge (U on a hull edge whose endpoints differ by a transposition, d(U) on that edge exactly, eps in {0.02, 0.1}). Runs were free (sep 0.02) or constrained away from trivial sets (dist_genperm >= 0.15, dist_blockdiag >= 0.15, sep >= 0.05, penalty weight 1e4). Separate second-order test (edgehess.py): gradient and Hessian of f = Re(e^{-i theta} d) - h_H(theta) on transposition edge curves of H.

runs.outcome: every restart ends at a generalized permutation matrix (dist_genperm < 3e-14 for all 948); top 5 at 60 digits between -1.0e-18 and -8.6e-22

10 nontrivial near-contacts; 9 have a and -b concyclic (collinear hull), 1 has an eigenvalue coincidence a_5 = -b_2; the rest stop at m about -1.3e-5 or below on hull edges with dist_blockdiag pinned at the 0.15 bound
every restart ends at a generalized permutation matrix (dist_genperm < 1e-15 for all 85); top 5 at 60 digits between -7.5e-18 and -1.4e-20
1 contact (a and -b concyclic); best non-degenerate m = -9.243e-6 (edge type, dist_blockdiag pinned at 0.150), confirmed at 60 digits
